name: Fuji Shinkyu
description: A calm, geometric and airy theme for small acupuncture, moxibustion and bodywork clinics, drawn like a quiet pulse-point chart: fine rings, gold points and hairline meridians organise every page, with numbered points strung on one line, journal entries hanging from a meridian, circle portraits and a breathing ring that widens and settles at a resting pace, plus a treatment menu with times and prices, a first-visit guide, opening hours and an appointment request form, in wisteria lavender and deep murasaki plum on pale washi white with soft grey-lilac and one muted gold accent.
